source: Instructors will run the first aid session twice on Friday. The morning session begins at 9 a.m., and the afternoon session begins at 2 p.m. Both sessions cover the same material. Staff who need step-free access should book the afternoon session because the morning room is upstairs and the lift is being repaired.

The park may open the footpath this weekend if contractors finish replacing the rails. The playground will remain closed until a separate inspection has taken place. Children can still use the play area near the entrance. The council has asked visitors to keep dogs away from the fenced construction area.

Nora handed the spare microphone to Isaac during the break. Isaac gave it to the sound technician, who put it back in the cupboard. The organizer did not borrow the spare microphone. She will ask the sound technician to check it before the next event.

For 3 months, the team tested an app that sends a message before a bill is due. The participants missed fewer payments than they had in the previous 3 months. The team cannot tell whether the app made the difference because there was no comparison group. The next trial will use a comparison group.

The branch will continue accepting returns while the checkout desk is closed. Visitors can return books by putting them in the slot near the entrance. People returning a borrowed laptop must wait until the desk reopens. Staff will update the notice on Thursday if the repairs take longer than planned.
